hero.title: IT student?
hero.description: Lapikud is an organization with three teams where you can do real work — build software, help people with tech, or organize events. Joining does not commit you to anything.
hero.aside: or first read what we do ↓

teams.title: Choose what truly fits you.
teams.subtitle: Each team has its own focus. You do not need to do everything — join the team that matches you.

items.title: Software
about: The software team builds things people actually use. We work on external projects like TipLAN, do code reviews, and use the same workflow as in real jobs — Git, PRs, and architecture discussions.
This is where your CV gets meaningful content. You do not need to be experienced — senior members will help you get started.
what: Build new features for external projects
Do code reviews and learn from each other
Participate in hackathons and external events
events: Demo nights — show what you built

items.title: Helpdesk
items.short: IT support for people who need it.
about: Helpdesk covers what lectures do not teach — diagnostics, hardware, operating system installation, and workstation setup. You work with real issues, not simulations.
We also run a public repair event with Remondiköök, where Tallinn residents can bring broken devices.
what: Diagnose and repair computers and other devices
Set up workstations and install software
Document solutions in a knowledge base
Support events from the IT side

items.title: Culture
items.short: A community does not maintain itself.
about: The culture team handles everything that keeps Lapikud alive outside of code. We plan events, manage social media channels, design materials in Canva and Figma, and organize larger events like ASI Karikas.
If you enjoy how organizations operate — communication, logistics, visuals — this is your team.
what: Plan and run team and public events
Design materials in Canva and Figma
events: ASI Karikas and other major events

mentor.title: Mentors
mentor.description: There is no need to worry about joining: mentors help new members settle in, explain what each team does, introduce other Lapikud members, and help with first tasks and questions.

join.title: Ready to join?
join.description: No prior experience is required in any team, even if it can be helpful. We try to find tasks suitable for every level, and if needed, we will squeeze some knowledge out of our own brains for you — meaning we will teach you how to do things.
